title: Capacity decision map and illustrated onboarding walkthrough for Dedicated first-run
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a decision-map-driven visual onboarding experience for Dedicated deployments that helps customers choose initial capacity and autoscaling policies. Deliverables: 6 hero illustrations (desktop + mobile crops), a step-by-step walkthrough artboard for the console, annotated screenshots for docs, microcopy variants for three locales, and an accessibility QA checklist. The flow should surface SLA tradeoffs, burst capacity options, and a confidence estimator that recommends a starting GPU pool size based on throughput targets.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive artboard created in Figma with annotated decision nodes and copy hooks
Six exported hero illustrations: 3 for initial onboarding headers and 3 smaller thumbnails for docs and emails
Annotated console screenshots (PNG + transparent overlay) for capacity estimator modal, autoscale policy selector, and SLA compare card
Microcopy variants for en-US, fr-FR, zh-CN with placeholders for dynamic values
Accessibility checklist passed: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for text, keyboard focus states, alt text for all illustrations
Hand-off artifacts uploaded to Drive and linked from PRD; engineering accepted artefacts via checklist in GitHub PR
